```{r libs}

library(tidyverse)
library(rinat)
```

```{r}
# iNaturalist place_id
#  - find it in the URL of a place page on inaturalist.org
place <- 72841
```


## Test pull

```{r}
# Get up to 500 research grade observations from 2026
temp <- get_inat_obs(
  place_id = place,
  maxresults = 500,
  quality = "research",
  year = 2026
)

as_tibble(temp)     # one row per observation
```


## Species snapshot for a place

###iNat's own stats, top 5 only

```{r}
stats <- get_inat_taxon_stats(bounds, place = place)

str(stats, max.level = 1)

stats$total     # number of different taxa (species, genus, etc.) observed

# The 5 most observed species
indepth <- stats$species_counts
str(indepth, max.level = 2)
```


```{r}
find_place_by_name <- function(name) {
  resp <- request("https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/places/autocomplete") |>
    req_url_query(q = name) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_json()

  map(resp$results, \(p) tibble(id = p$id, name = p$display_name)) |> list_rbind()
}

find_place_by_name("Acadia National Park")
```



```{r}
top5_species <- tibble(
  scientific_name = indepth$taxon$name,
  iconic_taxon_name = indepth$taxon$iconic_taxon_name,
  count = parse_number(indepth$count)     # count comes in as text
)
top5_species
```
